title: FBI Photo B17
doc_notes: This document is an FBI report to AARO regarding a single still image of a UAP, noting that the timestamp on the image is incorrect.

incidents.summary: Two small, dark, circular objects observed in a grainy monochrome image captured by a U.S. military system.
incidents.explanation: The operator was unable to positively identify the UAP.
incidents.quote: Two small, dark, circular objects are visible near the center of the frame.
